name: engine
description: The autonomous engine — all four modes in one plugin. Build mode (`engine`, user-invocable via /engine): given any task, designs a gate that can prove it done (and can fail), gets human sign-off on the target, then builds and self-verifies against that gate until green — stopping at a committed slice. Ships three sibling mode skills that fire on their own triggers: engine-review (findings), engine-planning (spec/plan), engine-infra (system state). Install the companion agent-loops plugin for the foundation playbook.
